messages:
Erin: quick heads-up — aiming to ship patch 3.2.1 this Thu 18:00 PST. Drafting internal RN + staff blurb. Need: pin version, rollback criteria, deploybot cues, and a final tidy of the changelog.
Mike: got it. can we pin to 3.2.1-rc2? that build includes the hotfix for KV cache edge case.
Erin: yes pin to 3.2.1-rc2 -> release tag 3.2.1. Lia, can you take the RN microcopy? need very clear rollback notes for oncall.
Lia: will do. pushing a short draft in a sec. Also: please confirm the change window — 18:00 PST is ok for EU oncall?
Sam: 18:00 PST is 02:00 CET — ok for small impact window, but I'll be on-call. I'll own rollback if needed.
Jules: marketing note: keep internal announcement terse — 1-2 bullets + link to playbook. We'll circulate to CS and Sales after internal pin.
Mike: deploy plan: canary → 10% → 50% → full. Suggest 20m between stages. Canary metrics: latency p95 < 250ms, errorrate < 0.5%. If either breaches, abort and roll back.
Erin: sounds good. define rollback criteria explicitly in RN. Lia, include this line: "If canary error rate >= 0.5% or p95 increased >30% vs baseline, rollback to 3.2.0 immediately."
Lia: added. Draft RN snippet below: 
```
- 3.2.1: KV cache race condition fix, improves tail latency for short queries.
- Rollback criteria: canary error rate >= 0.5% OR p95 > 30% above baseline.
- Pin: 3.2.1-rc2 -> 3.2.1
- Change window: Thu 18:00 PST, expected 10m impact during canary.
```
Erin: nice. Mike — deploybot hooks? can you add the staged rollout job and alert thresholds?
Mike: yes. Deploybot will post progress in this thread. webhook config: `deploybot --stage canary --percent 10 --wait 1200 --metric-checks p95:250ms,error:0.5`
Deploy Bot: Canary started for release 3.2.1 at 8172639500. Stage: 10%. Monitoring p95 and error rate.
Sam: saw canary metrics — p95 210ms, error 0.12%. green so far.
Jules: draft internal announce (short): 
"Patch 3.2.1 rolling Thu 18:00 PST — fixes a KV cache race causing rare 500s. Oncall: Sam. Rollback criteria and runbook linked: <link>"
Erin: perfect. final checklist: 1) pin to 3.2.1-rc2 -> done, 2) RN posted to /internal/rn-drafts -> Lia to upload, 3) deploybot job configured -> Mike, 4) oncall notified -> Sam confirmed, 5) marketing microcopy ready -> Jules.
Lia: RN uploaded to /internal/rn-drafts/3.2.1-draft.md, link: https://internal/docs/rn/3.2.1-draft
Mike: deploybot progressed to 50% at 8172639800. metrics: p95 220ms, error 0.14% — continuing to 100%.
Deploy Bot: Rollout reached 100% at 8172639950. No thresholds breached. Release 3.2.1 marked as deployed.
Sam: monitoring live traffic for 30m. so far stable. If anything, I'll trigger rollback by running: `deploybot rollback --to 3.2.0` and ping #eng-oncall.
Erin: thanks all. After 30m validation, we'll send internal announce to CS + Sales and then public release note. Leaving this thread open for any post-deploy notes. :thumbsup:
